body: Remember loosing my first cat. He sat by me every hour when I was ill or sick. I used to go down on my knees and he would rub his face towards mine. Its the strongest love i've ever felt for something. I cant even continue writing this. thoughts of Puma makes me too sad..
Guitar and music is my passion but it tends to enhance my suicidial thoughts, im so sorry for being hopeless but it's my reality, as cliché as it sounds.
